policy: Only official RSS/Atom endpoints advertised by the publisher may be fetched. Entries are discovery candidates only and must pass release-date and TMDB movie-identity verification before publication.

feeds.scope: Netflix official newsroom announcements; includes films and series
Amazon Japan official news; requires entertainment and movie review
Apple TV Press official announcements; includes films and series

note: Feed discovery never publishes dates or movie identity directly. Series, ambiguous titles and entries without an independently verified premiere date remain review candidates.
